value.rationale: The fractional-order sine–cubic model is a natural prior object with periodic sine branches. An exact all-real fractional stability count identifies previously unreported remote spectral branches, an order-dependent difference from integer dynamics, and a sharp inverse-square accumulation of stability thresholds. It is an intrinsically motivated spectral classification useful for bifurcation interpretation, not merely a routine parameter substitution.
